Specification: This module specifies a simple real-time framework with a single clock variable now ranging over a bounded set of natural-number time values from 0 to MaxReal. It defines an initialization predicate for time, a real-time next-state relation RTNext(v) that either advances time while keeping an auxiliary state component v unchanged or keeps time fixed while allowing v to change, and a timer transition rule TimerNext that updates a timer variable t based on whether an action A occurs or is disabled. The specification also defines a fairness condition RTFairness(v) requiring weak fairness of time-progress steps above every real threshold, but it does not define a complete top-level Spec operator in this file.
